evals.prompt: Check if AI retrieval crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) are allowed in robots.txt on https://example.com.
evals.expected_output: Access status per crawler distinguishing retrieval from training bots.
assertions: Retrieval crawlers are evaluated per RFC 9309 rules
Training token blocks (e.g. GPTBot) are reported as observations, not critical defects
Raw HTML visible word count is reported

evals.prompt: Audit https://example.com for meta robots noindex directives, canonical consolidation, and Single-Page Application (SPA) raw rendering gaps.
evals.expected_output: Evaluation of meta directives, canonical targets, and raw unrendered HTML word count.
assertions: Noindex directives on landing page trigger critical NOINDEX_EXCLUSION findings
External canonical tags trigger CANONICAL_FRAGMENTATION findings
Raw HTML word count < 25 words with unrendered app container triggers RENDERED_CONTENT_GAP
